latest_release.name: v5.3.7
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* fix(tia): answer the stream_lock support probe by @jaspertey in https://github.com/pestphp/pest/pull/2029
* fix(tia): parse SFC entries when building the JS module graph by @atymic in https://github.com/pestphp/pest/pull/1919
* release: 5.3.7 by @MrPunyapal in https://github.com/pestphp/pest/pull/2037

## New Contributors
* @jaspertey made their first contribution in https://github.com/pestphp/pest/pull/2029
* @atymic made their first contribution in https://github.com/pestphp/pest/pull/1919

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pestphp/pest/compare/v5.3.6...v5.3.7

hot_issues.title: [Bug]: Using `--parallel` causes overall process to fail with no reporting as to why even though all tests pass
[Bug]: mutation testing fails if directory is called `Datasets`
[Bug]: Coverage for Livewire v4 SFC/MFC not working
[4.x] Abstract classes cannot be final - strict preset
[Browser plugin] playwright run-server is never killed on Debian/Ubuntu (/bin/sh = dash): orphaned node process after every run, terminal hangs when output is piped
[Bug]: Inputs with "*" character not located after 4.1.0 update
[Bug]: TIA: memory grows steadily per test while recording since `ReadCapture` (#2006)

discussions.title: TIA shared baseline support for GitLab?
Preset strict() incompatible with default laravel project.
Print tests in descrbe() in a tree format
Idea: First-class Gherkin (`.feature`) support in Pest
